inventory.description: Pure, host-testable products of Packages/VisualCore: VisualCoreMath, VisualCoreSimulation, VisualCoreScenes, VisualCoreShaderSource, VisualCoreEffectsGraph, VisualCoreDiagnostics, VisualCoreAudioDSP, VisualCorePersistence, VisualCoreParameters, VisualCoreExperience (+ VisualCoreTestSupport for test targets). iOS products of Packages/VisualCoreRendering: VisualCoreRendering, VisualCoreEffects, VisualCoreUI, VisualCoreAudio (links AVFAudio), VisualCoreAutomation, VisualCoreExperienceHost. Since A06 (checked 2026-11-14) VisualCoreAudio holds AudioSource/ResumableAudioSource, MicrophoneAudioSource, FileAudioSource, DemoAudioSource, MicrophonePermission and AudioSessionEventMonitor, and VisualCoreAudioDSP holds SampleRingBuffer, SpectrumAnalyzer, BandLayout, LevelMeter, OnsetDetector, FeatureSmoother, FeatureExtractor, AudioMapping/AudioMapper and AnalysisQuality; Audio Odyssey (A07) and Oscilloscope Studio reuse them. For the scope: VisualCoreScenes has the 2D SceneNode/Primitive graph (rect, circle, two-point line, polygon <= 256 points), PointerEvent and GestureArbiter; VisualCoreMath has Camera2D and PlaneViewport (anchored pinch); VisualCoreRendering has PrimitiveRenderer, TrailLayer and StillCapture. No trigger, timebase, decimation, multi-point strip, two-channel source, square or sweep demo exists in any product (checked 2026-11-14).

RenderHost (@MainActor) owns the EGL display, context and surfaces over ANGLE's Metal backend (EGLDisplayProvider), the CAMetalLayer RenderView, the FrameScheduler and context generations; pause/resume, replaceScene, recreateContext, renderOffscreen and destroy; scenes implement RenderScene setup/resize/render/teardown. All EGL and GL work runs on the main thread. Audio capture and analysis never touch GL: the audio callback writes the bounded SampleRingBuffer, analysis runs off the realtime thread and only finished feature values cross to the main thread at the frame boundary; trigger search, decimation and trace building are CPU work whose finished vertex data is uploaded on the main thread. Oscilloscope Studio adds no EGL or GL context of its own.

ResourceRegistry creates buffers, textures, programs and render targets under a ResourceBudget and rejects stale handles after a generation change. ShaderProgram, ShaderBundle and ShaderLibrary (#include expansion with line maps) compile bundled GLSL; the vc/ library holds color, field, hash, noise, palette and sdf helpers. PrimitiveRenderer draws a 2D SceneNode tree as one batched triangle list through Camera2D; TrailLayer keeps a fading persistence image; FullScreenShaderScene and the effects graph (copy, colorMatrix, blur, bloom, distort, composite, feedback, flashLimit) complete the 2D drawing set.

ExperienceSession opens, checkpoints, closes and recovers an Experience on one RenderHost, applies the quality level (QualityGovernor over the experience's QualityProfile, fed by DeviceConditions thermal state and Low Power Mode) and memory/scene-phase events; ExperienceShell adapts an ExperiencePresenter (scene, controls) to Experience; ExperienceCore is the GPU-free state; ExperienceStorage is the per-experience sandbox; the one app registers experiences in ExperienceRegistry and Catalog/registrations.json (Oscilloscope Studio joins in A08-P01; it stays unregistered and unavailable in A08-P00; scripts/check_experience_packages.py forbids unregistered targets). project.yml already carries the shared NSMicrophoneUsageDescription added for A06 (checked by BundleTests), so no new privacy answer is needed.

XcodeGen spec project.yml for the one app (target VisualCore), package schemes via scripts/xcodebuild_package.py, app tests via scripts/xcodebuild_app.py, and scripts/release_check.py: 93 named steps listed by --list on 2026-11-14 (shared checks, package and app builds/tests, per-experience release, copy-claims and verify steps of A01-A07 on iOS 27 and 26, release audits of the one app, the seven reference regression steps).

Oscilloscope Studio owns its domain (SignalWindow, ScopeSettings, ScopeTrace, SpectrumSettings, scope modes, gain, freeze, cursors, spectrum axis wording, accuracy statements and the spoken measurement description) and UI under Packages/ExperiencesCreative/OscilloscopeStudio/ (Core GPU-free, CoreTests, Experience with Adapter/, ExperienceTests; created in A08-P01, not present today). VisualCore owns reusable machinery: two-channel capture, permission and session recovery (VisualCoreAudio), ring buffer, spectrum, levels, trigger/timebase, decimation and demo signals (VisualCoreAudioDSP), trace strips (VisualCoreScenes, drawn by VisualCoreRendering), quality and persistence (constitution Principle II, A08 section). ProjectM stays in the harness.

Reference pinned at d93edd1, read-only; scripts/run_reference_baseline.py lists the ordered reference steps; scripts/check_reference_clean.py checks the submodule; the 7 release-check steps run in two chunks via release_check.py --only (reference-engine-xcframework, reference-build-projectm-ios-sim, reference-clean; reference-test-anglerendering-ios27, reference-test-anglerendering-ios26, projectm-reference-ios27, projectm-reference-ios26), recorded in docs/apps/oscilloscope-studio/regression-baseline.md.

matrix.capability: Line rendering: anti-aliased-width 2D line segments in a scene-graph tree, batched into one premultiplied triangle list on the main thread through a 2D camera (grid, graticule, markers, single segments)
matrix.notes: Primitive.line(Vec2, Vec2, width:) is the scene graph's only line (a two-point segment); PrimitiveRenderer is public and tested in VisualCoreRenderingTests/PrimitiveRendererTests and SceneGraphTests. Enough for the graticule, trigger marker and cursors; a many-point trace is M02.

matrix.capability: Bounded multi-point trace strip: one polyline of up to N points (no more points than pixels) built from a sample window and drawn as one bounded vertex buffer, with no per-frame node allocation
matrix.source: brainstorm: line rendering, waveform buffers; manual render stage 3; v0.1 features 01-03
matrix.notes: No polyline or strip primitive exists: Primitive has rect, circle, two-point line and a filled polygon (<= 256 points). Music Lab draws its waveform as one SceneNode per two-point .line segment (MusicLabPresenter, drawnSampleCount nodes), which is experience code and does not scale to a pixel-width trace. G-TRACESTRIP: bounded trace strip in VisualCoreScenes, drawn through VisualCoreRendering, A08-P02.

matrix.capability: Waveform buffers: lock-free mono sample ring buffer written on the audio thread, snapshot of the latest N samples read off the realtime thread with a running write count for sample-rate accounting
matrix.source: brainstorm: waveform buffers; manual algorithm decision 1
matrix.notes: Tested in VisualCoreAudioDSPTests/SampleRingBufferTests and VisualCoreAudioTests/HotPathFootprintTests; capacity 1,024-262,144 samples.

matrix.capability: Real-time data visualization: per-frame level, peak, dBFS, FFT bands and smoothing computed off the realtime thread, finished values handed to the main thread at the frame boundary
matrix.notes: Built in A06-P01..P03; tested in VisualCoreAudioDSPTests (FeatureExtractorTests, LevelMeterTests, FeatureSmootherTests, AnalysisTimingTests).

matrix.capability: Shader effects: phosphor-style persistence (fading trail image), glow/bloom and colour passes, full-screen GLSL with the shared vc/ library
matrix.notes: TrailLayer is tested in VisualCoreRenderingTests/TrailLayerTests; FullScreenShaderScene, the effects graph and ShaderLibrary in their own test targets. Trail decay must respect Reduce Flashing (M23).

matrix.capability: Multiple visualization modes: switch between waveform, XY and spectrum scenes on one render host without a second context
matrix.notes: Tested in VisualCoreRenderingTests and VisualCoreExperienceHostTests; Music Lab switches its bars, rings and geometry scenes the same way. The scope modes themselves are experience domain.

matrix.capability: Time-domain waveform with adjustable gain, timebase and selectable trigger: rising/falling level-crossing detection with hysteresis and holdoff, a timebase window (samples per division from the sample rate) placed at the trigger point, auto/normal/single modes
matrix.source: v0.1 feature 01; manual algorithm decision 1; primary capability waveform/timebase/trigger
matrix.notes: SampleRingBuffer.latest returns the newest N samples with no trigger alignment; no trigger, crossing or timebase type exists in any product (grep 2026-11-14), and Music Lab's waveform free-runs. G-TRIGGER: TriggerDetector and TimebaseWindow in VisualCoreAudioDSP, A08-P02. Gain is a plain multiply in the experience. Built in A08-P01 (G-TRIGGER moved from A08-P02 because the manual's Phase 01 gate asks for a selectable trigger): level, rising/falling slope, hysteresis, auto and normal modes, TimebaseWindow (10 divisions, cap 4,096), tested in ScopeTriggerTests and OscilloscopeStudio ScopeAcquisitionTests. Single-shot capture arrives with freeze (G-SCOPEINTERACT, A08-P04).

matrix.capability: Display decimation: min/max reduction of a sample window to at most one column pair per pixel so the trace keeps peaks without drawing more geometry than pixels
matrix.source: manual algorithm decision 3; v0.1 features 01 and 04
matrix.notes: No decimation or min/max reducer exists (grep 2026-11-14); Music Lab draws a fixed drawnSampleCount. G-DECIMATION in VisualCoreAudioDSP, A08-P02.

matrix.capability: Two-channel (stereo) capture for the XY view: left and right sample streams kept separate from the source to the analysis buffers
matrix.source: v0.1 feature 02; manual validity risk routing
matrix.notes: Every shared source writes mono: AudioSource is 'a producer of mono Float audio samples' and MicrophoneAudioSource and FileAudioSource mix down to one channel. G-STEREO: two-channel capture (channel count reported, mono fallback labelled) in VisualCoreAudio, A08-P01. Built in A08-P01 for the test-signal and file paths (StereoSampleBuffer, StereoAudioSource, TestSignalAudioSource, StereoFileAudioSource; tested in StereoSampleBufferTests and StereoFileAudioSourceTests). The microphone stays mono through MicrophoneAudioSource; route-dependent stereo microphone capture is M26 (G-STEREOMIC, A08-P05).

matrix.capability: XY (Lissajous) plot mode: left/right sample pairs plotted as points in a square plane with persistence, mono input shown as a labelled diagonal
matrix.source: v0.1 feature 02; brainstorm: multiple visualization modes
matrix.notes: Camera2D, TrailLayer and the line primitive exist; pairing channels into points and the mono-input label are experience domain once G-STEREO and G-TRACESTRIP exist. G-XYMODE (app-local), A08-P03.

matrix.capability: FFT spectrum: windowed FFT with log-domain zero guard (-200 dB floor), bin-to-frequency mapping and band layouts
matrix.notes: Tested in VisualCoreAudioDSPTests/SpectrumAnalyzerTests, BandLayoutTests and DemoSignalTests (the 440 Hz and 1 kHz tones land on expectedBin).

matrix.capability: Spectrum annotation: frequency axis labels from bin frequencies and a relative dBFS axis (never SPL or volts), marking where the floor or clipping makes a value invalid
matrix.source: v0.1 feature 03 ('calibrated dB-style annotation where valid'); manual algorithm decision 4
matrix.notes: The numbers exist (expectedBin, LevelMeter.dBFS, magnitudesDB with its -200 dB floor); the axis labels, valid-range rules and wording are experience domain, as Music Lab's MetricText is. G-SPECTRUMLABELS (app-local), A08-P03.

matrix.capability: Freeze and capture: hold the displayed window while input keeps running, and save a still image of the screen
matrix.notes: StillCapture (tested in VisualCoreRenderingTests/StillCaptureTests) saves the frame and latest() copies a window; the freeze state that keeps input running is experience domain. G-SCOPEINTERACT (app-local), A08-P04.

matrix.capability: Cursors: draggable time/voltage-style and frequency/level cursors with readouts in relative units
matrix.notes: Pointer events, a line primitive and screen/plane conversion exist; cursor state and readouts are experience domain. G-SCOPEINTERACT (app-local), A08-P04.

matrix.capability: Touch zoom: anchored pinch zoom and pan of the plotted plane with gesture arbitration
matrix.notes: Tested in VisualCoreMathTests/PlaneViewportTests and VisualCoreScenesTests (GestureTests, PointerTrackerTests). Mapping the zoom to timebase/frequency span is part of G-SCOPEINTERACT.

matrix.capability: Demo synthetic generator: sine, square and sweep (chirp) signals with known frequency and amplitude for tests and the no-permission path, never played to the speaker
matrix.notes: DemoSignal.Mode offers sequence, tone440, tone1k and silence only (tested in DemoSignalTests); no square or sweep exists. G-DEMOWAVES: square and sweep modes in VisualCoreAudioDSP (DemoAudioSource follows), A08-P01. Built in A08-P01 as a new TestSignal beside DemoSignal (sine, naive square, logarithmic sweep, optional second channel), so A06/A07 digests stay unchanged; tested in TestSignalTests and TestSignalAudioSourceTests.

matrix.capability: Permission-aware audio input and safe microphone policy: shared usage string, permission state and request, denied/restricted handling, works without permission; analysis only, never monitored to the speaker
matrix.source: v0.1 feature 06; cross-cutting: audio sources and permission
matrix.notes: Built in A06-P01; tested in VisualCoreAudioTests (MicrophoneSourceTests, MicrophoneRecoveryTests); NSMicrophoneUsageDescription is already in project.yml.

matrix.capability: App-owned file and demo input behind one source interface with a status (idle, running, interrupted, failed)
matrix.notes: Built in A06-P01 and tested in VisualCoreAudioTests.

matrix.capability: Audio interruption, route change and media-services reset recovery
matrix.notes: Built in A06-P04 and tested through AudioSessionEventMonitor and MicrophoneAudioSource tests.

matrix.capability: Render host lifecycle: context loss, resize, background and memory warning rebuild everything from CPU state
matrix.source: cross-cutting: interruption recovery (renderer); manual state transitions
matrix.notes: Tested in VisualCoreRendering and VisualCoreExperienceHost tests.

matrix.capability: Persistence: scope settings presets (mode, gain, timebase, trigger, spectrum size) as versioned documents in a named library in per-experience storage
matrix.source: cross-cutting: persistence; v0.1 feature 04 (presets per manual P04)
matrix.notes: Tested in VisualCoreParametersTests, VisualCorePersistenceTests and VisualCoreExperienceTests; the ScopeSettings schema is experience domain. Sample windows are never persisted.

matrix.capability: Quality tiers and pause/resume: quality governor fed by thermal state and Low Power Mode, analysis cost tiers, session suspend/resume
matrix.notes: Tested in VisualCoreDiagnosticsTests (QualityGovernorTests), VisualCoreAudioDSPTests (AnalysisQualityTests) and VisualCoreExperienceHostTests.

matrix.capability: Reduce Motion and Reduce Flashing: system preferences observed; phosphor persistence and trace flashes limited
matrix.notes: Tested in VisualCoreSimulation, VisualCoreEffectsGraph and VisualCoreUI tests.

matrix.capability: Spoken measurement description: VoiceOver text for the current mode, trigger state, timebase, peak level in relative dBFS and dominant frequency, rate-limited
matrix.notes: AnnouncementSink is public and tested (VisualCoreUITests/AccessibilityPlayersTests); the measurement wording is experience domain, as Music Lab's MetricText is. G-MEASUREA11Y (app-local), A08-P05.

matrix.capability: Units, calibration and accuracy: relative dBFS only, sample-rate and latency accounting, clipping indication, route (built-in, wired, Bluetooth) limitations stated; no calibrated SPL or volts
matrix.source: cross-cutting: units and calibration; manual validity risk (units, clipping, latency, routing, calibration); manual P05
matrix.notes: dBFS and peak are tested (LevelMeterTests) and route changes are observed (AudioSessionEventTests); the accuracy statement, clipping threshold and the route/latency audit are experience domain. G-ACCURACY (app-local), A08-P05.

matrix.capability: Route-dependent two-channel microphone capture (external stereo inputs) with the channel count shown
matrix.source: v0.1 feature 02; manual validity risk routing
matrix.notes: Split from G-STEREO in A08-P01: the shared microphone source mixes to mono, which the scope shows as one channel; stereo routes need the device-route audit. G-STEREOMIC, VisualCoreAudio, A08-P05.

gaps.justification: Found in A08-P00: DemoSignal.Mode has sequence, tone440, tone1k and silence only; test fixtures for any scope or tuner need square and sweep signals.
gaps.test: Host tests: square and sweep modes are deterministic per seed, the square's fundamental lands on expectedBin and its odd harmonics fall by 1/n, the sweep covers its start-end range in the stated time, amplitudes stay within the declared peak, existing modes unchanged (API baseline additive)

gaps.justification: Found in A08-P00: AudioSource is mono by contract and MicrophoneAudioSource/FileAudioSource mix down.
gaps.test: Simulator/host tests: a two-channel source reports its channel count, keeps left and right separate into two ring buffers, falls back to mono with a labelled state when the route has one channel, mono callers unchanged

gaps.justification: Found in A08-P00: no trigger, crossing or timebase type exists in any product.
gaps.test: Host tests: rising and falling crossings found at the exact sample with hysteresis rejecting noise, holdoff respected, auto mode free-runs after the timeout, the timebase window spans samples-per-division x divisions from the sample rate, NaN/Inf rejected, no allocation in the steady state

gaps.justification: Found in A08-P00: no display decimation exists; the manual requires no more points than pixels.
gaps.test: Host tests: min/max reduction to N columns keeps every peak of a square and an impulse, output never exceeds the column count, identity when samples <= columns, bounded work per frame

gaps.justification: Found in A08-P00: the scene graph's only line is a two-point segment; per-segment nodes do not scale to a pixel-width trace.
gaps.test: Host tests of the strip builder (bounded point count, finite-value guard, width and joins) and simulator tests that PrimitiveRenderer (VisualCoreRendering) draws a strip of N points in one batch with pixels equal to the equivalent segments and no per-frame allocation

gaps.justification: The numbers come from VisualCoreAudioDSP; the axis wording and validity rules are Oscilloscope Studio's domain.
gaps.test: Host tests: axis labels at the right bin frequencies for 48 and 44.1 kHz, levels shown as relative dBFS, values at the -200 dB floor or above clipping marked invalid, no SPL or volt wording

gaps.justification: Plotting channel pairs is experience domain on top of G-STEREO and G-TRACESTRIP.
gaps.test: Host tests: equal-phase sines give a diagonal, 90-degree phase gives a circle, a 1:2 ratio gives the expected figure, mono input is labelled

gaps.justification: Freeze, cursor and zoom state are the scope's own interaction model over shared StillCapture, PlaneViewport and pointer events.
gaps.test: Host tests: freeze holds the shown window while the ring buffer keeps advancing, cursor readouts in time/frequency and relative dBFS, pinch zoom maps to timebase and frequency span within limits; capture through StillCapture

gaps.justification: The measurement wording is experience domain; AnnouncementSink already exists in VisualCoreUI.
gaps.test: Host tests of the measurement description for each mode and state (no signal, clipping, frozen, demo, mono) and rate-limited announcement through a RecordingAnnouncementSink

gaps.justification: Accuracy statements and the route/latency audit are the experience's claims (manual P05); the shared numbers are tested in VisualCoreAudioDSP.
gaps.test: Host tests: demo-signal frequency and dBFS readouts within stated tolerance, clipping flagged at full scale, copy contains no calibrated, certified, laboratory or medical claim; route and latency limitations recorded for the device campaign

gaps.justification: Split from G-STEREO in A08-P01: the test-signal and file paths keep two channels; the microphone stays mono until the device-route audit shows which routes deliver two channels.
gaps.test: Simulator tests with a two-channel input double: the channel count is reported, left and right stay separate, a one-channel route falls back to mono with a labelled state; device measurements in the campaign

traceability.item: v0.1 feature 01: time-domain waveform with adjustable gain/timebase and selectable trigger
v0.1 feature 02: stereo XY/Lissajous view using available stereo input
v0.1 feature 03: FFT spectrum mode with dB-style annotation where valid
v0.1 feature 04: freeze/capture, cursors and touch zoom
v0.1 feature 05: demo synthetic sine/square/sweep generator for tests
v0.1 feature 06: permission-aware audio input state and safe mic monitoring policy
cross-cutting: interruption recovery, persistence, quality tiers

negative.rule: No EGL display, context, surface or GL path of its own and no second renderer; all drawing goes through VisualCore's RenderHost on OpenGL ES -> ANGLE -> Metal
No ProjectM types, engine or presets and no ProjectM code reused; the scope imitates no ProjectM visuals
negative.source: constitution A08 consumer, not fork; CLAUDE.md rule 12

negative.rule: No networking, accounts, analytics, tracking or advertising
Audio never leaves the device: microphone and file samples are analysed in memory and never recorded, uploaded or persisted; sample windows are not exported in version 0.1
negative.source: constitution A08 audio privacy; manual later ideas (CSV export only with consent, not in scope)

negative.rule: No system-wide capture of other apps' or protected audio; only the microphone, files the person opens and the bundled demo generator through public Apple APIs
negative.source: manual non-goal: arbitrary system audio interception

negative.rule: No microphone monitoring to the speaker or headphones and no demo signal played out; input is analysed and drawn only (no feedback path)
negative.source: v0.1 feature 06 safe mic monitoring policy; spec FR-A08-006

negative.rule: No calibrated, certified, laboratory or medical accuracy claims; levels are relative dBFS, never SPL or volts, and source limitations (route, clipping, latency) are annotated
negative.source: manual non-goals: certified calibrated instrument, medical or lab-grade accuracy; spec FR-A08-006

negative.rule: No fork or copy of VisualCore, ANGLE or projectm-ios, no standalone app target and no copy of A06/A07 audio code; generic needs become VisualCore gaps
negative.source: ADR-0009; constitution A08 reuse first; CLAUDE.md rule 1

reasons: The render host, 2D line drawing (Primitive.line through PrimitiveRenderer and Camera2D), persistence trails, shader effects, mode switching, pinch zoom, presets, quality tiers, session lifecycle and accessibility exist with tests: 14 of 25 rows are available.

The audio path builds today: VisualCoreAudio (microphone with permission, app-owned files, demo, interruption recovery) and VisualCoreAudioDSP (SampleRingBuffer, SpectrumAnalyzer with expectedBin and a -200 dB floor, LevelMeter dBFS, FeatureSmoother, AnalysisQuality) were built for A06 and are reused unchanged; the shared NSMicrophoneUsageDescription is already in project.yml.

All gaps are additive and owned: G-DEMOWAVES (VisualCoreAudioDSP) and G-STEREO (VisualCoreAudio) in A08-P01; G-TRIGGER and G-DECIMATION (VisualCoreAudioDSP) and G-TRACESTRIP (VisualCoreScenes, drawn by VisualCoreRendering) in A08-P02; app-local G-SPECTRUMLABELS and G-XYMODE (A08-P03), G-SCOPEINTERACT (A08-P04), G-MEASUREA11Y and G-ACCURACY (A08-P05).

Oscilloscope Studio stays unregistered until A08-P01 creates Packages/ExperiencesCreative/OscilloscopeStudio with its targets and first real domain rules, so the experience package check and the one app are unchanged.
